base_profile.market_label: San Antonio / JBSA-Lackland Military Housing Market
base_profile.installation_type: Joint Base / Training / Medical / Cyber & ISR / Flying / Mission Support
base_profile.host_or_major_command: 502d Air Base Wing (installation support) / 37th Training Wing (primary training mission)
base_profile.primary_mission_summary: JBSA-Lackland is a major multi-mission Air Force installation on the west side of San Antonio and home to the 37th Training Wing, the largest training wing in the U.S. Air Force. The 37th TRW conducts Basic Military Training for Air Force and Space Force enlisted accessions, technical training, international English-language training, Spanish-language partner-nation training, medical specialty training, and Department of Defense Military Working Dog training. The installation also hosts major cyber and intelligence, medical, Air National Guard fighter, reserve, special warfare, and installation-support organizations.
mission_partners: Air Force Installation and Mission Support Center
Cryptologic & Cyber Systems Division / Air Force Life Cycle Management Center
base_profile.pcs_personality: Training-heavy, high-traffic, newcomer-heavy, family-relevant, and strongly shaped by gate access, BAH fit, commute timing, school considerations, and neighborhood selection.
base_profile.base_bluf: For a PCS to JBSA-Lackland, gate access and duty location matter as much as straight-line distance. Compare housing choices by realistic gate commute, BAH and total monthly cost, school-zone needs, family services, and assignment horizon—not mileage alone.

pcs_watchouts.title: Gate and VCC hours can change
pcs_watchouts.message: Use the official JBSA gate-hours page immediately before travel. As of 2026-09-15, Valley Hi VCC is 24/7 and Luke East VCC is temporarily closed with processing moved to Valley Hi.

pcs_watchouts.title: Visitor access procedures are security-sensitive
pcs_watchouts.message: Visitors should follow current JBSA identification, sponsorship and background-check requirements. For access concerns, contact the JBSA-Lackland BDOC at 210-671-2018.

pcs_watchouts.title: Distance is not the same as commute
pcs_watchouts.message: Neighborhoods should be compared by realistic gate access, duty location and traffic timing.

pcs_watchouts.title: School assignments are residence-specific
pcs_watchouts.message: On-base residents are served by Lackland ISD; off-base school assignment must be verified by exact property address.

pcs_watchouts.title: BAH is not the full affordability picture
pcs_watchouts.message: Compare rent or mortgage against income, debt, utilities, taxes, insurance, HOA, savings goals and assignment length.

pcs_watchouts.title: Published installation population is not a live headcount
pcs_watchouts.message: The current public Lackland profile still reports more than 24,000 active duty, 10,000 DoD civilians, and 11,000 contractors and family members combined, but the underlying data year is not stated.

pcs_watchouts.title: Some official JBSA pages retain legacy housing-office details
pcs_watchouts.message: Use the current Air Force Housing installation page for Lackland office hours and email; verify before travel.

pcs_watchouts.title: On-base housing is not automatically the best financial answer
pcs_watchouts.message: Compare availability, BAH treatment, commute, home fit, schools and lifestyle before deciding.
